chains.name: McDonald's
chains.src: mcdonalds.com (Canada) item nutrition, every size McDonald's lists (14 Nov 2026). Allergens are McDonald's own list for each item. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Burger King
chains.src: Burger King Canada Nutrition Explorer (14 Nov 2026), each item as served with its standard toppings. May-contain includes shared cooking equipment. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Tim Hortons
chains.src: Tim Hortons Nutrition Information, Canadian edition (14 Nov 2026). Iced Capps, Chai Latte and London Fog are left out: their rows couldn't be read reliably from the guide. No allergens yet: they're in a separate chart

chains.name: A&W
chains.src: A&W Canada menu and nutrition pages (feed behind web.aw.ca/en/our-menu), per item and per size as listed. Kids' packs are split into their parts (burger or strips, apple slices, MadeGood bar, Milk2Go). Left out: 7 rows with no nutrition figures (plush toys, table spreads) or whose energy does not add up (A&W Root Beer Shake (small) (energy does not add up); Rodeo Rooty (no figures); Paddling Rooty (no figures); Hiking Rooty (no figures); Poutine Rooty (no figures); Fishing Rooty (no figures); Kraft Table Spreads (no figures)). Allergens from A&W's per-ingredient allergen table. (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Popeyes
chains.src: Popeyes Canada Nutrition Guide 2025 (PDF, "current as of November 2025", linked from popeyes.ca). Nothing left out. No allergens: the only allergen guide Popeyes Canada links is dated December 2023. (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Subway
chains.src: Subway Canada Nutrition Information PDF (October 2026), linked from subway.com/en-CA. Subs are per 6-inch; salads without dressing. Left out: breads, single vegetables, cheeses, seasonings, individual proteins and soups. No allergens: the Canadian allergen chart covers ingredients, not finished items. (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Mary Brown's Chicken
chains.src: Mary Brown's Allergen and Nutritionals PDF (July 2026), linked from marybrowns.com/menu. Left out: 13 rows printed per share of a multi-serving box (large sides and 4- to 27-piece buckets), and 1 rows whose figures do not add up (Apple Pie). No allergens: the allergen chart groups items differently from the nutrition table. (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.
